Finding: A machine-learning risk model for recurrent upper-GI bleeding in cirrhosis was assessed in a prospective development cohort and an independent external cohort. Source check: Source checked. Not independent scientific confirmation.

Finding: Across 5,000 brewery batches, models using routine process records explained at most about 8% of held-out turbidity variance; no nonlinear model beat linear baselines and a learning curve plateaued near R²=.10. Do student perceptions mirror reality? A mixed-methods study to evaluate the accuracy, utility and efficiency of AI-assisted feedback in introductory mathematics courses

Source check: Source checked. Not independent scientific confirmation.

Finding: Two introductory mathematics courses were studied using Gemini 2.5 Pro to draft scores/feedback from submissions and course references. Study One compared human-only (159 students) with human-curated AI (89); Study Two compared AI, peer and professor feedback. This is a specific educational study, bounded to two courses and short-term feedback rather than learning outcomes.

Source check: Source checked. Not independent scientific confirmation.
